mssp.title: MSSP
mssp.subtitle: Managed Security Services Platform
mssp.summary: A managed security services platform with an installable PWA and data-visualisation views.

caseStudy.scope: I was the only front-end developer on the project. I designed the full UI in Figma and built the entire front-end, including the installable PWA and the data-visualisation views.

payesh.title: Payesh
payesh.subtitle: Occupational Health Monitoring System
payesh.summary: Multi-tenant enterprise platform featuring granular RBAC controls, 30+ specialized clinical examination form modules, and corporate health contract management.

caseStudy.context: Payesh is an enterprise occupational health monitoring platform connecting national corporations to certified occupational medical clinics with precise role-based access control.
caseStudy.scope: Engineered 30+ specialized medical examination form modules (audiometry, spirometry, organ-specific evaluations, lab panels) using Redux Toolkit for cross-form state persistence, dynamic onboarding wizards, and SMS verification.

picopet.title: PicoPet
picopet.subtitle: Bilingual Veterinary Healthcare Platform
picopet.summary: Bilingual (Persian/English) portal connecting pet owners with veterinarians: online appointment booking, digital prescriptions, vaccination tracking, and invoicing.

caseStudy.context: PicoPet is a comprehensive veterinary platform streamlining clinic discovery, specialist appointments, and pet medical history.
caseStudy.scope: Implemented clinic and veterinarian discovery modules, visit history, invoice workflows, role-based dashboards, and full RTL/LTR bilingual parity.

salam-operator.title: Salam Operator
salam-operator.subtitle: Ministry of Health National Healthcare Platform
salam-operator.summary: Official national health operator platform under the Ministry of Health: online telemedicine consultations, appointment scheduling, and integrated patient health records.

caseStudy.context: Salam Operator is one of Iran's three official national healthcare operators under the Ministry of Health, providing national telemedicine and appointment infrastructure.
caseStudy.scope: Engineered front-end interfaces for telemedicine consultations, video and text appointment booking, patient health record views, and REST integration for real-time patient synchronization at national scale.

ganotic.title: Ganotic
ganotic.subtitle: Health & Wellness E-Commerce Platform
ganotic.summary: Production health platform featuring a Next.js PWA storefront, custom React admin panel, unified design system, and strict SEO & accessibility standards.

caseStudy.context: Ganotic is a specialized e-commerce brand and web platform in wellness and organic supplements, conceived, designed and engineered from scratch.
caseStudy.scope: Designed design system in Figma and built front-ends for both apps: an installable Next.js PWA storefront with Persian RTL and high SEO score, and a React admin panel featuring order management, catalog filters, and payment gateway integration.

sepehr-pharmacy.title: Sepehr Online Pharmacy
sepehr-pharmacy.subtitle: Inventory & Order Management Portal
sepehr-pharmacy.summary: Drug inventory tracking with expiration management, multi-insurance prescription processing, and real-time WebSocket order delivery across active branches.

sepehr-salamat.title: Sepehr Salamat
sepehr-salamat.subtitle: Comprehensive Medical Office System
sepehr-salamat.summary: Insurance-supported prescription workflows, online scheduling, and comprehensive patient records with dedicated high-performance panels for doctors, receptionists, and patients.
